title.narrative: Health Security Program in Western and Central Africa, Nigeria - Phase II

description.narrative: Building from World Bank and partner efforts, the proposed Program provides a platform to strengthen critical core capacities for prevention, preparedness, and response to health emergencies. The Program will invest in key interconnected systems for improving health security designed with a One Health approach, capitalizing on multisectoral collaboration, and convening partner investments.
Increase regional collaboration and health system capacities to prevent, detect, and respond to health emergencies in the Federal Republic of Nigeria.
